page.title: Enchantment Calculator
page.heading: Enchantment calculator
page.reset_help: Clear your setup and settings, and see the first screen again (saved setups stay)

bedrock.label: Bedrock
bedrock.help: Bedrock Edition: each enchantment costs only the levels it adds, Impaling is cheaper, and there is no Sweeping Edge

wanted.intro: Find the cheapest anvil order to put enchanted books on an item. Pick an item and its enchantments, then follow the steps.
wanted.example: Try an example: a fully enchanted helmet
wanted.preset_best_help: The usual best enchantments for this item, at max level, without curses
wanted.preset_swap_help: The best set, with {name} in place of what it conflicts with

cost_help.one: About {levels} level to add this from a book, before any prior work
cost_help.other: About {levels} levels to add this from a book, before any prior work

wanted.short_help: Your books and items in section 2 can't reach the level chosen here.

books.automatic_help: One book for each enchantment chosen in section 1
books.custom_help: List your own books and items, with copies and prior work

prior_work_cost.one: Its prior work adds {levels} level to each merge it's in.
prior_work_cost.other: Its prior work adds {levels} levels to each merge it's in.

books.prior_work_none: Never used on an anvil, so no extra cost.
books.edit_line: Change enchantments, or drag onto another entry to move it
books.coverage_label: Enchantments chosen in section 1, reached or not
books.undo_remove_help: Put the removed entry back where it was
books.duplicate_help: Add a copy of this entry, to change it
books.type_label: Add one book by typing its enchantments, with commas between them
books.reorder_help: Drag to reorder, or focus and press the up and down arrow keys
books.copies_help: How many identical copies of this you have, e.g. a stack of the same book
books.prior_work_help: How many times this has already been used on an anvil. Each use makes later merges more expensive.
books.undo_help: Undo the last suggestion you applied
books.unwanted_help: Not chosen in Enchantments. It will still go on the item and cost levels.

ranking.rank_by: The best order is picked by the four tiles below: the order with the lowest value in the first tile wins, and the next tiles break ties. Drag a tile, or use its ‹ › arrows, to change which counts most.
ranking.rank_help_label: How the best order is chosen

xp.label: XP
xp.help: Total XP points spent. Higher levels cost more XP each.

max_step.label: Max level
max_step.help: Most levels spent on one anvil use

prior_work.label: Prior work
prior_work.help: Prior work on the result: the lower it is, the cheaper later anvil use on it will be

ranking.allow_conflicts_help: For mods that let conflicting enchantments go together
ranking.level_limit_help: No anvil use may cost more levels than this
ranking.level_limit_label: Most levels allowed per anvil use
ranking.rename_help: Type a name to rename the item in the last step (+1 level). Leave it blank for no rename.
ranking.rename_label: New name for the finished item
ranking.your_level_help: Your XP level now, to see what you have left after each step
ranking.set_needed_help: Set your level to exactly what the steps not yet ticked need
ranking.use_level_help: Follow your level through the steps: the level before and after each one

results.slow_search: {count} entries: this may take a while.
results.too_many_different: Too many different entries. Repeated books are fine, but at most 20 different ones.
results.no_valid_order: No valid order: these can't be combined.
results.no_valid_order_within: No valid order within the {limit}-level limit.
results.extra_help: These came along on your books or items. They are included in the cost.
results.round_help: These steps don't need each other's results, so do them in any order.
results.step_done_help: Tick off steps as you do them. Kept in this browser.
results.anvil_wear_help: Each anvil use has a 12% chance to damage the anvil. A new anvil breaks on its third damage.
results.copy_steps_help: Copy the steps as text, e.g. to paste in a chat
results.print_help: Print the steps, or save them as a PDF
results.text_totals: {levels} levels in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step
results.worker_failed: The calculator failed to load. Check the browser console for details.
results.metadata_failed: Couldn't load the enchantment data. Serve this folder over HTTP instead of opening the file directly.

descriptions.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites
descriptions.binding_curse: Can't be taken off once worn
descriptions.blast_protection: Less damage and knockback from explosions
descriptions.breach: Hits ignore some of the target's armor
descriptions.channeling: Thrown in a thunderstorm, it calls lightning down on the target
descriptions.density: Smash attacks do more damage the farther you fall
descriptions.fire_protection: Less fire damage, and burning stops sooner
descriptions.fortune: More drops from ores and crops
descriptions.frost_walker: Turns water to ice as you walk over it
descriptions.infinity: Shooting doesn't use up arrows (you need one)
descriptions.loyalty: The trident comes back after it's thrown
descriptions.luck_of_the_sea: Better chance of treasure when fishing
descriptions.mending: Experience you pick up repairs the item
descriptions.projectile_protection: Less damage from arrows and other projectiles
descriptions.riptide: Throwing it in water or rain launches you with it
descriptions.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves, like ores and glass
descriptions.soul_speed: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil
descriptions.thorns: Hurts mobs and players that hit you
descriptions.wind_burst: Smash attacks bounce you back up into the air
